label: GO WITH CONDITIONS
call: Pitch Option B today at $6,000 upfront setup plus $2,000/month, backed by a 30-day viewing guarantee; downsell terms to $3,000 upfront plus $3,000 on Day 30 if resisted.

why.point: Option A makes $100k mathematically impossible under a 10-client solo capacity cap.
Free pilots trap solo founders in unpaid tech support, causing operational burnout before Day 30.
Risk reversal through a 30-day viewing guarantee replaces the need for local case studies.

minority.quote: With customer number one, getting a fanatical user who loves the product and gives a public case study is worth far more than squeezing out every dollar of setup fee.
minority.would_have_to_be_true: Zero Dubai brokerages will buy without seeing an existing local competitor's logo first.

next_steps.action: Run prospect call with live WhatsApp demo and pitch $6k setup ($3k split fallback) with 30-day guarantee.
Complete client #1 onboarding within 48 hours and monitor first 50 conversations.
Reach 3 paying clients ($18k–$24k collected) and hire onboarding assistant.

kill_criteria: If 25 qualified agency directors hear the offer and see the live demo with zero upfront closes, halt and re-evaluate.
conditions: Trigger live WhatsApp demo to prospect's phone before quoting price
Anchor at $6,000; fallback only to $3,000 upfront + $3,000 on Day 30
Pre-authorize Day 30 payment at contract signing
Guarantee requires client to generate at least 30 inbound leads/month
Standardize onboarding to under 3 hours and hire VA from first client cash

fights.crux: Free pilot vs upfront paid setup
fights.story: Founder leaned toward a 14-day free pilot. Hormozi and Martell proved it breaks the 94-day math and burns out the founder. Graham conceded once the math was presented.
Resolved by pairing a live WhatsApp demo during the call with a 30-day 10-viewing money-back guarantee, eliminating buyer risk.

amendments.amendment: Pre-authorize the second $3,000 tranche at contract signing for split terms.
amendments.reason: Eliminates credit risk and payment chasing while keeping cash flow predictable.

cheapest_test: Have today's prospect text the Balos demo number during the call and observe their reaction.
revisit: Day 30 with numbers on calls held, close rate on $6k vs $3k, and average hours spent per onboarding.
